5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that in the F.I.R. the informant herself has stated that she was having an affair with the applicant for the past about one year prior to lodging of the F.I.R. and that she got married to some other person about 11 months prior to lodging of the F.I.R., prima facie, the offence of section 376, IP.C. is not made out against the applicant, accordingly the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
